Metadata.title: Medilog — Smart Medical Records Platform
Metadata.description: Medilog is a smart medical records platform for managing patient files, appointments, visits, and prescriptions securely.

Home.title: Everything about your patient, in one place.
Home.description: Medilog is a smart medical platform that helps doctors and clinics manage records, appointments, visits, and prescriptions with ease and confidence.
Home.proof: Trusted by modern doctors and clinics
Home.featuresDescription: Medilog gives you a clearer view and better control over every part of the patient journey.

featuresList.title: Organized records
featuresList.description: Keep medical history, diagnoses, and prescriptions in one clear profile.

featuresList.title: Effortless scheduling
featuresList.description: Organize your calendar and keep a quick view of every patient's visit.

featuresList.title: Data-led decisions
featuresList.description: Track your clinic activity and uncover insights that help you grow.

featuresList.title: One connected team
featuresList.description: Give your team the right tools for a smoother care experience.

Home.workflowDescription: From the first appointment to follow-up, every step is organized so you can focus on what matters.

workflow.title: Add patient details
workflow.description: Create an organized medical profile in seconds.

workflow.title: Record the visit
workflow.description: Document diagnoses, prescriptions, and notes in one place.

workflow.title: Track progress
workflow.description: Return to a clear timeline and make better decisions.

Home.securityTitle: Your patients' data is always protected
Home.securityDescription: Privacy and security are at the heart of the experience, so you can work with confidence.
securityPoints: A timeline that's easy to review
Home.storyEyebrow: Real experiences, even when starting small
Home.storyTitle: Made for the busy clinic day
Home.storyDescription: Every detail in Medilog is designed to make your day calmer and give you more time to focus on patients.

testimonials.quote: I can see the patient's full history before the visit starts, without searching through scattered files.
testimonials.name: Dr. Sarah Khaled

testimonials.quote: Organizing appointments and daily follow-ups saved our team hours of calls and coordination.
testimonials.name: Mona Ali

testimonials.quote: The interface is clear and fast, and sensitive information stays visible only to the right person.
testimonials.name: Dr. Omar Hassan

Home.ctaDescription: Organize your day, understand your data, and deliver better care with Medilog.
